description: Daily climate observations for one German DWD station over a date range: mean/max/min temperature, precipitation, sunshine hours, snow depth, wind speed and gusts, humidity, pressure and cloud cover, each with DWD quality flags. Ranges older than ~500 days come from the quality-controlled historical archive (back to the station's first record, some to the 1800s); recent days from the daily update. Max 1000 days per call. Get station_id from dwd_stations.

station_id.description: DWD station number (e.g. "1048" Dresden-Klotzsche, "433" Berlin-Tempelhof, "3379" München-Stadt)

name: dwd_daily
title: Dwd Daily
